CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.nsai_build_native_passages(doc text, model text)
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE parent public.knowledge_embeddings; nodes jsonb; node jsonb; node_key text;
  vectors jsonb; coordinates double precision[]; expected integer; observed integer=0;
BEGIN
  IF model<>'6fd5d72fe4589f189f8ebc006442dbb529bb7ce38f8082112682524616046452' THEN RETURN 0; END IF;
  SELECT * INTO STRICT parent FROM public.knowledge_embeddings WHERE document_id=doc AND model_sha256=model;
  IF NOT parent.provenance_complete THEN RETURN 0; END IF;
  SELECT coalesce(knowledge->'nodes','[]'::jsonb) INTO STRICT nodes FROM public.document_knowledge WHERE document_id=doc;
  vectors=coalesce(parent.payload->'vectors','{}'::jsonb);
  IF jsonb_typeof(nodes)<>'array' OR jsonb_typeof(vectors)<>'object' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid native passage inventory'; END IF;
  SELECT count(*) INTO expected FROM jsonb_array_elements(nodes) n WHERE n->>'kind'='passage';
  IF expected>10000 OR (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_object_keys(vectors))<>expected THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Incomplete native passage inventory'; END IF;
  FOR node IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(nodes) WHERE value->>'kind'='passage' LOOP
    node_key=node->>'id';
    IF node_key IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof(vectors->node_key) IS DISTINCT FROM 'array'
      OR jsonb_array_length(vectors->node_key)<>384
      OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(vectors->node_key) v WHERE jsonb_typeof(v)<>'number') THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid native passage vector'; END IF;
    SELECT array_agg(value::double precision ORDER BY ordinality) INTO coordinates
      FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(vectors->node_key) WITH ORDINALITY v(value,ordinality);
    INSERT INTO public.native_semantic_passages(document_id,model_sha256,embedding_sha256,node_id,locator,page,text,source_segments,vector,source_ids,provenance_complete)
      VALUES(doc,model,parent.artifact_sha256,node_key,node->>'locator',(node->>'page')::integer,node->>'text',
        coalesce(node->'source_segments','[]'::jsonb),coordinates,parent.source_ids,true);
    observed=observed+1;
  END LOOP;
  RETURN observed;
END $function$
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.nsai_cancel_semantic_job(doc text, expected_epoch bigint)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE job public.semantic_jobs; observed public.source_index_state; target text; next_epoch bigint;
BEGIN
 IF public.nsai_actor_role() IS DISTINCT FROM 'operator' OR coalesce(current_setting('nsai.job_id',true),'')<>'' OR NOT public.nsai_source_is_owner(doc)
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Source unavailable' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 SELECT pending_job_id INTO target FROM public.source_index_state WHERE document_id=doc;
 SELECT * INTO job FROM public.semantic_jobs WHERE id=target FOR UPDATE;
 SELECT * INTO observed FROM public.source_index_state WHERE document_id=doc FOR UPDATE;
 IF NOT FOUND OR job.id IS NULL OR expected_epoch IS NULL OR expected_epoch<1 OR observed.epoch<>expected_epoch OR observed.pending_job_id IS DISTINCT FROM job.id
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Stale index state' USING ERRCODE='40001'; END IF;
 IF job.requested_actor IS DISTINCT FROM public.nsai_actor() THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Source unavailable' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 IF job.state NOT IN('queued','running') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Only pending indexing can be cancelled' USING ERRCODE='40001'; END IF;
 UPDATE public.semantic_jobs SET state='cancelled',lease_token=NULL,lease_expires_at=NULL,error_code='cancelled' WHERE id=job.id;
 UPDATE public.source_index_state SET state=CASE WHEN current_publication_id IS NULL THEN 'cancelled' ELSE 'ready' END,epoch=epoch+1 WHERE document_id=doc RETURNING epoch INTO next_epoch;
 INSERT INTO public.semantic_job_events(job_id,event_type,attempt,control_details) VALUES(job.id,'cancelled',job.attempts,jsonb_build_object('actor',public.nsai_actor(),'expected_epoch',expected_epoch,'epoch',next_epoch,'previous_state',job.state));
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('job_id',job.id,'state','cancelled','epoch',next_epoch,'index_state',CASE WHEN observed.current_publication_id IS NULL THEN 'cancelled' ELSE 'ready' END);
END $function$

 RETURNS semantic_jobs
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER

AS $function$
DECLARE job public.semantic_jobs;
BEGIN

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.nsai_claim_context(spans jsonb, selected text[], revision_filter text, page_filter integer[])
 RETURNS SETOF jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
 SET plan_cache_mode TO 'force_custom_plan'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF spans IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof(spans)<>'array' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid passage scope' USING ERRCODE='22023'; END IF;
  IF jsonb_array_length(spans) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 2000 OR octet_length(spans::text)>1048576
    OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(spans) item WHERE
      jsonb_typeof(item)<>'object' OR jsonb_typeof(item->'document_id') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
      OR jsonb_typeof(item->'locator') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
      OR (item-'document_id'-'locator')<>'{}'::jsonb
      OR length(item->>'document_id') NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 200
      OR length(item->>'locator') NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 200) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid passage scope' USING ERRCODE='22023'; END IF;
  RETURN QUERY
  WITH selected_spans AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT s.document_id,s.locator FROM jsonb_to_recordset(spans) AS s(document_id text,locator text)
  ), readable AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT c.id,c.subject,c.predicate,c.value,c.locator,c.document_id,c.revision,
      c.reviewed_by,c.status,c.source_ids,c.provenance_complete,c.original_sha256
      FROM public.nsai_readable_claim_projection(selected,revision_filter,page_filter,true) c
  ), seeds AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (c.document_id,c.locator,c.subject,c.predicate,c.value,c.status) c.*
      FROM readable c JOIN selected_spans s ON s.document_id=c.document_id AND s.locator=c.locator
      ORDER BY c.document_id,c.locator,c.subject,c.predicate,c.value,c.status,c.id
  ), witnesses AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (c.subject,c.predicate,c.value) c.* FROM readable c
      WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM seeds s WHERE s.subject=c.subject AND s.predicate=c.predicate)
      ORDER BY c.subject,c.predicate,c.value,(c.status='verified') DESC,c.id
  )
  SELECT to_jsonb(context) FROM (SELECT * FROM seeds UNION SELECT * FROM witnesses) context
    ORDER BY context.id LIMIT 2001;
END $function$
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.nsai_claim_review_page(page_limit integer, before_time timestamp with time zone, before_id text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
 SET plan_cache_mode TO 'force_custom_plan'
AS $function$
DECLARE result jsonb;
BEGIN
  IF page_limit IS NULL OR page_limit NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 100
    OR (before_time IS NULL)<>(before_id IS NULL)
    OR (before_id IS NOT NULL AND length(before_id) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 200) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid claim page' USING ERRCODE='22023'; END IF;
  WITH readable AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT * FROM public.nsai_readable_claim_projection(NULL,NULL,NULL,false)
  ), displayed AS (
    SELECT c.id,c.document_id,c.subject,c.predicate,c.value,c.locator,c.status,c.revision,
      c.reviewed_by,c.source_ids,c.provenance_complete,c.created_at FROM readable c
    WHERE before_time IS NULL OR (c.created_at,c.id)<(before_time,before_id)
    ORDER BY c.created_at DESC,c.id DESC LIMIT page_limit+1
  ), witnesses AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON(c.subject,c.predicate,c.value,(c.status NOT IN ('rejected','superseded')))
      c.id,c.document_id,c.subject,c.predicate,c.value,c.locator,c.status FROM readable c
    ORDER BY c.subject,c.predicate,c.value,(c.status NOT IN ('rejected','superseded')),
      (c.status='verified') DESC,c.id LIMIT 2001
  )
  SELECT jsonb_build_object('total',(SELECT count(*) FROM readable),
    'verified',(SELECT count(*) FROM readable WHERE status='verified'),
    'items',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(d) ORDER BY d.created_at DESC,d.id DESC) FROM displayed d),'[]'::jsonb),
    'witnesses',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(w)) FROM witnesses w),'[]'::jsonb)) INTO result;
  RETURN result;
END $function$
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.nsai_claim_semantic_job(model_sha text, active_actors text[], max_running integer, lease_seconds integer)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE job public.semantic_jobs; expired public.semantic_jobs; token uuid; policy_epoch bigint;
BEGIN
  IF public.nsai_actor()<>'legacy-service' OR coalesce(current_setting('nsai.job_id',true),'')<>''
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Orchestrator context required' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
  IF model_sha IS NULL OR model_sha !~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$' OR active_actors IS NULL OR cardinality(active_actors)>1000
    OR max_running IS NULL OR lease_seconds IS NULL
    OR max_running NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 2 OR lease_seconds NOT BETWEEN 30 AND 300
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid bounded job admission'; END IF;
  PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(878720);
  FOR expired IN UPDATE public.semantic_jobs SET
    state=CASE WHEN attempts>=3 THEN 'failed' ELSE 'queued' END,
    lease_token=NULL,lease_expires_at=NULL,available_at=clock_timestamp(),error_code='stale-lease'
    WHERE state='running' AND lease_expires_at<=clock_timestamp() RETURNING * LOOP
      INSERT INTO public.semantic_job_events(job_id,event_type,attempt,error_code)
        VALUES(expired.id,CASE WHEN expired.state='failed' THEN 'failed' ELSE 'requeued' END,expired.attempts,'stale-lease');
      UPDATE public.source_index_state SET state=CASE WHEN expired.state='failed' THEN 'failed' ELSE 'queued' END,
        epoch=epoch+1 WHERE document_id=expired.document_id AND pending_job_id=expired.id;
  END LOOP;
  IF (SELECT count(*) FROM public.semantic_jobs WHERE state='running')>=max_running THEN RETURN NULL; END IF;
  SELECT j.* INTO job FROM public.semantic_jobs j
    JOIN public.documents d ON d.id=j.document_id
    JOIN public.document_knowledge k ON k.document_id=j.document_id
    WHERE j.state='queued' AND j.attempts<3 AND j.available_at<=clock_timestamp() AND j.model_sha256=model_sha
      AND (j.requested_actor='legacy-service' OR j.requested_actor=ANY(active_actors))
      AND d.source_version=j.source_revision AND d.original_sha256=j.source_sha256 AND k.artifact_sha256=j.knowledge_sha256
      AND ((j.requested_actor='legacy-service' AND d.owner_scope='legacy-shared') OR d.owner_scope=j.requested_actor)
    ORDER BY (SELECT max(previous.last_claimed_at) FROM public.semantic_jobs previous
              WHERE previous.requested_actor=j.requested_actor) NULLS FIRST,j.priority DESC,j.created_at,j.id
    LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE OF j SKIP LOCKED;
  IF NOT FOUND THEN RETURN NULL; END IF;
  SELECT coalesce((SELECT epoch FROM public.document_policy_versions WHERE document_id=job.document_id),0) INTO policy_epoch;
  token=gen_random_uuid();
  UPDATE public.semantic_jobs SET state='running',attempts=attempts+1,lease_token=token,
    lease_expires_at=clock_timestamp()+make_interval(secs=>lease_seconds),last_claimed_at=clock_timestamp(),
    claimed_policy_epoch=policy_epoch,error_code=NULL WHERE id=job.id RETURNING * INTO job;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.nsai_document_visible(doc text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE owner_id text; actor_id text; policy_epoch bigint;
BEGIN
  IF NOT public.nsai_source_scope_allows(doc) THEN RETURN false; END IF;
  SELECT owner_actor INTO owner_id FROM public.document_owners WHERE document_id=doc;
  IF owner_id IS NULL THEN RETURN public.nsai_legacy_context(); END IF;
  actor_id=public.nsai_actor();
  IF actor_id !~ '^local-user-[a-z][a-z0-9_-]{0,63}$'
    OR public.nsai_actor_role() NOT IN ('operator','viewer','reviewer','admin')
    OR NOT public.nsai_private_can_read(doc,actor_id) THEN RETURN false; END IF;
  IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.private_transaction_reads
      WHERE transaction_id=pg_current_xact_id() AND document_id=doc AND actor=actor_id) THEN
    -- Locks source policy and contributing groups through transaction commit.
    -- Admin reads insert their audit here, before the caller can commit bytes.
    policy_epoch=public.nsai_private_authorize_read(doc,actor_id,public.nsai_actor_role());
    INSERT INTO public.private_transaction_reads(transaction_id,document_id,actor,epoch)
      VALUES(pg_current_xact_id(),doc,actor_id,policy_epoch) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;
  END IF;
  RETURN true;
END $function$
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.nsai_enqueue_semantic_job(job_id text, doc text, model_sha text, knowledge_sha text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE inserted_id text; actor_id text; src public.documents;
BEGIN
  SELECT * INTO src FROM public.documents WHERE id=doc;
  IF NOT FOUND OR NOT public.nsai_document_visible(doc) OR
    NOT ((src.owner_scope=public.nsai_actor() AND public.nsai_actor_role()='operator') OR
      (src.owner_scope='legacy-shared' AND public.nsai_legacy_context()))
    OR coalesce(current_setting('nsai.job_id',true),'')<>''
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Source unavailable' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
  IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.document_knowledge WHERE document_id=doc AND artifact_sha256=knowledge_sha)
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Knowledge generation mismatch'; END IF;
  actor_id=CASE WHEN src.owner_scope='legacy-shared' THEN 'legacy-service' ELSE public.nsai_actor() END;
  INSERT INTO public.semantic_jobs(id,document_id,requested_actor,source_revision,source_sha256,knowledge_sha256,model_sha256)
    VALUES(job_id,doc,actor_id,src.source_version,src.original_sha256,knowledge_sha,model_sha)
    ON CONFLICT(document_id,knowledge_sha256,model_sha256) DO NOTHING RETURNING id INTO inserted_id;
  IF inserted_id IS NULL THEN
    SELECT id INTO inserted_id FROM public.semantic_jobs
      WHERE document_id=doc AND knowledge_sha256=knowledge_sha AND model_sha256=model_sha;
    RETURN inserted_id;
  END IF;
  INSERT INTO public.source_index_state(document_id,pending_job_id,state) VALUES(doc,inserted_id,'queued')
    ON CONFLICT(document_id) DO UPDATE SET pending_job_id=EXCLUDED.pending_job_id,state='queued',epoch=source_index_state.epoch+1;
  INSERT INTO public.semantic_job_events(job_id,event_type,attempt) VALUES(inserted_id,'queued',0);
  RETURN inserted_id;
END $function$
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.nsai_fail_semantic_job(job_id text, token uuid, code text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE job public.semantic_jobs;
BEGIN
  IF public.nsai_actor()<>'legacy-service' OR coalesce(current_setting('nsai.job_id',true),'')<>''
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Orchestrator context required' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
  IF code NOT IN ('encoder-unavailable','invalid-artifact','stale-lease','authorization-changed','cancelled','processing-failed','capacity-exhausted')
    OR code IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid bounded error code'; END IF;
  UPDATE public.semantic_jobs SET state=CASE WHEN attempts>=3 OR code='capacity-exhausted' THEN 'failed' ELSE 'queued' END,
    lease_token=NULL,lease_expires_at=NULL,error_code=code,available_at=clock_timestamp()+interval '5 seconds'
    WHERE id=job_id AND state='running' AND lease_token=token RETURNING * INTO job;
  IF NOT FOUND THEN RETURN false; END IF;
  UPDATE public.source_index_state SET state=CASE WHEN job.state='failed' THEN 'failed' ELSE 'queued' END,
    epoch=epoch+1 WHERE document_id=job.document_id AND pending_job_id=job.id;
  INSERT INTO public.semantic_job_events(job_id,event_type,attempt,error_code)
    VALUES(job.id,CASE WHEN job.state='failed' THEN 'failed' ELSE 'requeued' END,job.attempts,code);
  RETURN true;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.nsai_governed_storage_account()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE previous_bytes bigint=0; next_bytes bigint=0; delta integer=0;
  used bigint; records bigint;
BEGIN
  IF TG_OP='UPDATE' AND NEW.payload IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.payload THEN RETURN NEW; END IF;
  IF TG_OP<>'INSERT' THEN previous_bytes=octet_length(OLD.payload::text); END IF;
  IF TG_OP<>'DELETE' THEN next_bytes=octet_length(NEW.payload::text); END IF;
  IF TG_OP='INSERT' THEN delta=1; ELSIF TG_OP='DELETE' THEN delta=-1; END IF;
  -- AFTER triggers run only after the row's existing RLS/source checks. The
  -- counter and row roll back together on capacity failure or caller rollback.
  PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(878711);
  SELECT record_count,canonical_bytes INTO STRICT records,used
    FROM public.governed_storage_usage WHERE singleton FOR UPDATE;
  IF records+delta>2000 OR used-previous_bytes+next_bytes>134217728 OR next_bytes>16777216 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Governed artifact capacity reached' USING ERRCODE='54000';
  END IF;
  UPDATE public.governed_storage_usage SET record_count=records+delta,
    canonical_bytes=used-previous_bytes+next_bytes WHERE singleton;
  IF TG_OP='DELETE' THEN RETURN OLD; END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END $function$
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.nsai_guard_audit_head()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE head_id bigint; head_sha text;
BEGIN
  -- Preserve policy-before-ledger ordering, including direct app INSERTs.
  -- Legacy records with unknown provenance retain their existing RLS behavior.
  IF (session_user='nsai_app' OR current_setting('role',true)='nsai_app')
    AND NEW.provenance_complete AND NOT public.nsai_sources_visible(NEW.source_ids,true) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Audit source unavailable' USING ERRCODE='42501';
  END IF;
  PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(878701);
  SELECT id,sha256 INTO head_id,head_sha FROM public.audit_events ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1;
  IF NEW.previous_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM coalesce(head_sha,repeat('0',64))
    OR (head_id IS NOT NULL AND NEW.id<=head_id) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Stale audit head; retry with the global head' USING ERRCODE='40001';
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.nsai_library_lexical_search(exact_query text, alternate_query text, entity_filter text, selected text[], revision_filter text, page_filter integer[], result_limit integer)
 RETURNS SETOF jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
 SET plan_cache_mode TO 'force_custom_plan'
AS $function$
DECLARE exact_terms tsquery; alternate_terms tsquery; entity_terms tsquery;
BEGIN
  IF coalesce(current_setting('nsai.job_id',true),'')<>'' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Request context required' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
  IF exact_query IS NULL OR length(exact_query)>1000 OR alternate_query IS NULL OR length(alternate_query)>8000
    OR (entity_filter IS NOT NULL AND length(entity_filter)>8000)
    OR result_limit IS NULL OR result_limit NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 51
    OR (selected IS NOT NULL AND (cardinality(selected) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 1000 OR array_ndims(selected)<>1 OR array_position(selected,NULL) IS NOT NULL))
    OR (page_filter IS NOT NULL AND (cardinality(page_filter) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 100 OR array_ndims(page_filter)<>1 OR array_position(page_filter,NULL) IS NOT NULL
      OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM unnest(page_filter) p WHERE p NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 1000)))
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid lexical search bounds'; END IF;
  exact_terms=plainto_tsquery('english',exact_query);
  alternate_terms=websearch_to_tsquery('english',alternate_query);
  IF entity_filter IS NOT NULL THEN entity_terms=websearch_to_tsquery('english',entity_filter); END IF;
  RETURN QUERY
  WITH authorized AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT d.id FROM public.documents d
    WHERE (selected IS NULL OR d.id=ANY(selected))
      AND (revision_filter IS NULL OR d.source_version=revision_filter)
      AND public.nsai_index_source_readable(d.id)
  ), ranked AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT c.id,c.document_id,
      CASE WHEN exact_terms=alternate_terms THEN ts_rank_cd(c.search,exact_terms)*1.25
           ELSE (CASE WHEN c.search @@ exact_terms THEN ts_rank_cd(c.search,exact_terms) ELSE 0::real END)
             +(CASE WHEN c.search @@ alternate_terms THEN ts_rank_cd(c.search,alternate_terms) ELSE 0::real END)*0.25 END AS score
    FROM authorized d JOIN public.chunks c ON c.document_id=d.id
    WHERE (c.search @@ exact_terms OR c.search @@ alternate_terms)
      AND (entity_filter IS NULL OR c.search @@ entity_terms)
      AND (page_filter IS NULL OR (c.locator LIKE 'page:%' AND split_part(c.locator,':',2)=ANY(SELECT p::text FROM unnest(page_filter) p)))
    ORDER BY score DESC,c.id LIMIT result_limit
  )
  SELECT jsonb_build_object('id',c.id,'document_id',d.id,'title',d.title,'revision',d.source_version,
    'original_sha256',d.original_sha256,'media_type',d.media_type,'locator',c.locator,'text',c.text,'sha256',c.sha256,
    'page_coverage',d.manifest#>'{documents,0,metadata,pages}',
    'extraction_complete',CASE WHEN d.media_type='application/pdf' THEN coalesce((d.manifest#>>'{documents,0,metadata,complete}')::boolean,false) ELSE true END,
    'score',r.score)
  FROM ranked r JOIN public.chunks c ON c.id=r.id JOIN public.documents d ON d.id=r.document_id
  ORDER BY r.score DESC,r.id;
END $function$
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.nsai_library_semantic_search(query_vector double precision[], selected text[], revision_filter text, page_filter integer[], entity_filter text, result_limit integer)
 RETURNS SETOF jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE magnitude double precision;
BEGIN
  IF coalesce(current_setting('nsai.job_id',true),'')<>'' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Request context required' USING ERRCODE='42501';
  END IF;
  IF query_vector IS NULL OR cardinality(query_vector)<>384 OR array_ndims(query_vector)<>1
    OR array_lower(query_vector,1)<>1
    OR result_limit IS NULL OR result_limit NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 51
    OR (selected IS NOT NULL AND (cardinality(selected)=0 OR cardinality(selected)>1000
      OR array_position(selected,NULL) IS NOT NULL))
    OR (page_filter IS NOT NULL AND (cardinality(page_filter)=0 OR cardinality(page_filter)>100
      OR array_position(page_filter,NULL) IS NOT NULL
      OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM unnest(page_filter) p WHERE p NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 1000)))
    OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM unnest(query_vector) v WHERE v IS NULL OR v::text IN ('NaN','Infinity','-Infinity'))
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid semantic search bounds'; END IF;
  SELECT sqrt(sum(v*v)) INTO magnitude FROM unnest(query_vector) v;
  IF magnitude IS NULL OR abs(magnitude-1)>0.00001 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Normalized query vector required'; END IF;
  RETURN QUERY
  WITH authorized AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT d.id,e.model_sha256,e.artifact_sha256
    FROM public.source_index_state s
    JOIN public.semantic_publications p ON p.id=s.current_publication_id AND p.document_id=s.document_id
    JOIN public.documents d ON d.id=s.document_id
    JOIN public.knowledge_embeddings e ON e.document_id=d.id AND e.model_sha256=p.model_sha256
      AND e.artifact_sha256=p.embedding_sha256
    JOIN public.document_knowledge k ON k.document_id=d.id AND k.artifact_sha256=p.knowledge_sha256
    WHERE p.model_sha256='6fd5d72fe4589f189f8ebc006442dbb529bb7ce38f8082112682524616046452'
      AND (selected IS NULL OR d.id=ANY(selected))
      AND (revision_filter IS NULL OR d.source_version=revision_filter)
      AND public.nsai_index_source_readable(d.id)
      AND public.nsai_sources_visible(e.source_ids,e.provenance_complete)
      AND public.nsai_sources_visible(k.source_ids,k.provenance_complete)
  ), candidates AS (
    SELECT a.id,v.node_id,v.locator,v.page,v.text,v.source_segments,score.value AS score
    FROM authorized a
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
      -- OFFSET 0 preserves the source-correlated boundary: vector rows are
      -- fetched only after their source passed the authorization CTE.
      SELECT p.* FROM public.native_semantic_passages p
      WHERE p.document_id=a.id AND p.model_sha256=a.model_sha256 AND p.embedding_sha256=a.artifact_sha256
        AND (page_filter IS NULL OR p.page=ANY(page_filter))
        AND (entity_filter IS NULL OR p.search @@ websearch_to_tsquery('english',entity_filter))
      OFFSET 0
    ) v
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
      SELECT sum(item.value*query_vector[item.ordinality::integer]) AS value
      FROM unnest(v.vector) WITH ORDINALITY item(value,ordinality)
    ) score
    WHERE score.value>=0.35
  ), ranked AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT * FROM candidates ORDER BY score DESC,node_id LIMIT result_limit
  )
  SELECT jsonb_build_object('id',r.node_id,'document_id',r.id,'title',d.title,
    'revision',d.source_version,'original_sha256',d.original_sha256,'media_type',d.media_type,
    'locator',r.locator,'text',r.text,'score',r.score,'source_segments',r.source_segments,
    'page_coverage',d.manifest#>'{documents,0,metadata,pages}',
    'extraction_complete',CASE WHEN d.media_type='application/pdf'
      THEN coalesce((d.manifest#>>'{documents,0,metadata,complete}')::boolean,false) ELSE true END,
    'relation','heuristic_semantic_similarity','authority_granted',false)
  FROM ranked r JOIN public.documents d ON d.id=r.id ORDER BY r.score DESC,r.node_id;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.nsai_native_vector_valid(vector double precision[])
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE norm double precision;
BEGIN
  IF vector IS NULL OR array_ndims(vector)<>1 OR array_lower(vector,1)<>1 OR cardinality(vector)<>384

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.nsai_oauth_bind(p_provider text, p_subject text, p_mode text, p_target text)

 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE bound text; account public.oauth_accounts%ROWTYPE;
BEGIN
 IF public.nsai_actor()<>'legacy-service' OR public.nsai_actor_role()<>'service'
    OR nullif(current_setting('nsai.job_id',true),'') IS NOT NULL THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'Authentication service only' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 IF p_provider IS NULL OR p_provider NOT IN ('google','github') OR p_subject IS NULL
    OR p_subject !~ '^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{1,255}$'
    OR (p_provider='github' AND p_subject !~ '^[1-9][0-9]{0,18}$')
    OR p_mode IS NULL OR p_mode NOT IN ('login','signup','link-registry','link-provider') THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid verified identity binding'; END IF;
 IF (p_mode='login' AND p_target IS NOT NULL)
    OR (p_mode='signup' AND (p_target IS NULL OR p_target !~ '^local-user-oauth-[a-f0-9]{32}$'))
    OR (p_mode IN ('link-registry','link-provider') AND (p_target IS NULL OR p_target !~ '^local-user-[a-z][a-z0-9_-]{0,63}$')) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid canonical identity target'; END IF;
 PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(878735);
 SELECT actor INTO bound FROM public.oauth_bindings WHERE provider=p_provider AND subject=p_subject;
 IF bound IS NOT NULL THEN
  IF p_mode LIKE 'link-%' AND bound<>p_target THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'Provider identity is already linked' USING ERRCODE='23505'; END IF;
  IF p_mode='signup' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Provider identity already registered' USING ERRCODE='23505'; END IF;
  SELECT * INTO account FROM public.oauth_accounts WHERE actor=bound;
  IF p_mode LIKE 'link-%' AND account.authority<>(CASE WHEN p_mode='link-registry' THEN 'registry' ELSE 'provider' END) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'Canonical account authority conflict' USING ERRCODE='28000'; END IF;
 ELSE
  IF p_mode='login' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Provider identity is not registered' USING ERRCODE='28000'; END IF;
  IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.oauth_accounts WHERE actor=p_target)
     AND (SELECT count(*) FROM public.oauth_accounts)>=10000 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Account capacity exceeded'; END IF;
  IF p_mode='signup' THEN
   INSERT INTO public.oauth_accounts(actor,authority) VALUES(p_target,'provider');
  ELSIF p_mode='link-registry' THEN
   INSERT INTO public.oauth_accounts(actor,authority) VALUES(p_target,'registry') ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;
  END IF;
  SELECT * INTO account FROM public.oauth_accounts WHERE actor=p_target;
  IF NOT FOUND OR NOT account.enabled OR account.authority<>(CASE WHEN p_mode='link-registry' THEN 'registry' ELSE 'provider' END) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'Canonical account unavailable' USING ERRCODE='28000'; END IF;
  INSERT INTO public.oauth_bindings(provider,subject,actor) VALUES(p_provider,p_subject,account.actor);
 END IF;
 IF NOT account.enabled THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Canonical account unavailable' USING ERRCODE='28000'; END IF;
 INSERT INTO public.oauth_identity_events(actor,event,provider)
  VALUES(account.actor,CASE WHEN p_mode LIKE 'link-%' THEN 'link' ELSE p_mode END,p_provider);
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('actor',account.actor,'authority',account.authority);
END $function$
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.nsai_oauth_browser_assert(p_browser text, p_epoch bigint)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE current_epoch bigint;
BEGIN
 IF public.nsai_actor()<>'legacy-service' OR public.nsai_actor_role()<>'service'
    OR nullif(current_setting('nsai.job_id',true),'') IS NOT NULL THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'Authentication service only' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 SELECT epoch INTO current_epoch FROM public.oauth_browser_epochs WHERE browser_hash=p_browser FOR UPDATE;
 IF p_epoch IS NULL OR current_epoch IS NULL OR p_epoch<>current_epoch THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'Browser authentication changed' USING ERRCODE='28000'; END IF;
 UPDATE public.oauth_browser_epochs SET expires_at=clock_timestamp()+interval '24 hours' WHERE browser_hash=p_browser;
END $function$
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.nsai_oauth_browser_cancel(p_browser text)
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE changed integer;
BEGIN
 -- Shared lock order: global epoch admission, then browser row, then sessions.
 PERFORM public.nsai_oauth_browser_epoch(p_browser);
 UPDATE public.oauth_browser_epochs SET epoch=epoch+1,expires_at=clock_timestamp()+interval '24 hours' WHERE browser_hash=p_browser;
 DELETE FROM public.oauth_pending_states WHERE browser_hash=p_browser;
 WITH revoked AS (
  UPDATE public.oauth_login_sessions SET revoked_at=clock_timestamp()
  WHERE browser_hash=p_browser AND revoked_at IS NULL RETURNING actor
 ) INSERT INTO public.oauth_identity_events(actor,event) SELECT actor,'session-revoked' FROM revoked;
 GET DIAGNOSTICS changed=ROW_COUNT;
 RETURN changed;
END $function$
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.nsai_oauth_browser_epoch(p_browser text)
 RETURNS bigint
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE result bigint;
BEGIN
 IF public.nsai_actor()<>'legacy-service' OR public.nsai_actor_role()<>'service'
    OR nullif(current_setting('nsai.job_id',true),'') IS NOT NULL THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'Authentication service only' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 IF p_browser IS NULL OR p_browser !~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid browser binding'; END IF;
 PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(878736);
 DELETE FROM public.oauth_browser_epochs b WHERE b.expires_at<=clock_timestamp()
  AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.oauth_login_sessions s WHERE s.browser_hash=b.browser_hash
                 AND s.revoked_at IS NULL AND s.expires_at>clock_timestamp());
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.oauth_browser_epochs WHERE browser_hash=p_browser)
    AND (SELECT count(*) FROM public.oauth_browser_epochs)>=10000 THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'Authentication browser capacity exceeded'; END IF;
 INSERT INTO public.oauth_browser_epochs(browser_hash) VALUES(p_browser) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;
 SELECT epoch INTO result FROM public.oauth_browser_epochs WHERE browser_hash=p_browser FOR UPDATE;
 RETURN result;
END $function$
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.nsai_oauth_session_create(p_token text, p_csrf text, p_actor text, p_hours integer)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF public.nsai_actor()<>'legacy-service' OR public.nsai_actor_role()<>'service'
    OR nullif(current_setting('nsai.job_id',true),'') IS NOT NULL THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'Authentication service only' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 IF p_token IS NULL OR p_token !~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$' OR p_csrf IS NULL OR p_csrf !~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'
    OR p_actor IS NULL OR p_hours IS NULL OR p_hours NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 24 THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid login session'; END IF;
 PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(878735);
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.oauth_accounts WHERE actor=p_actor AND enabled) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'Canonical account unavailable' USING ERRCODE='28000'; END IF;
 IF (SELECT count(*) FROM public.oauth_login_sessions WHERE actor=p_actor AND revoked_at IS NULL AND expires_at>clock_timestamp())>=16
    OR (SELECT count(*) FROM public.oauth_login_sessions)>=100000 THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'Login session capacity exceeded'; END IF;
 INSERT INTO public.oauth_login_sessions(token_hash,csrf_hash,actor,expires_at)
  VALUES(p_token,p_csrf,p_actor,clock_timestamp()+make_interval(hours=>p_hours));
 INSERT INTO public.oauth_identity_events(actor,event) VALUES(p_actor,'session-created');
END $function$
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.nsai_oauth_session_create(p_token text, p_csrf text, p_actor text, p_hours integer, p_browser text, p_epoch bigint)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 PERFORM public.nsai_oauth_browser_assert(p_browser,p_epoch);
 PERFORM public.nsai_oauth_session_create(p_token,p_csrf,p_actor,p_hours);
 UPDATE public.oauth_login_sessions SET browser_hash=p_browser WHERE token_hash=p_token;
END $function$
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.nsai_oauth_session_resolve(p_token text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE result jsonb;
BEGIN
 IF nullif(current_setting('nsai.job_id',true),'') IS NOT NULL THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'Login session unavailable' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 SELECT jsonb_build_object('actor',a.actor,'authority',a.authority,'csrf_hash',s.csrf_hash) INTO result
 FROM public.oauth_login_sessions s JOIN public.oauth_accounts a ON a.actor=s.actor
 WHERE s.token_hash=p_token AND s.revoked_at IS NULL AND s.expires_at>clock_timestamp() AND a.enabled
 AND ((public.nsai_actor()='legacy-service' AND public.nsai_actor_role()='service')
      OR (public.nsai_actor()=a.actor AND public.nsai_actor_role() IN ('operator','viewer','reviewer','admin')));
 RETURN result;
END $function$
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.nsai_oauth_session_revoke(p_token text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE target text;
BEGIN
 IF nullif(current_setting('nsai.job_id',true),'') IS NOT NULL THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'Login session unavailable' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 UPDATE public.oauth_login_sessions SET revoked_at=clock_timestamp()
 WHERE token_hash=p_token AND revoked_at IS NULL
 AND ((public.nsai_actor()='legacy-service' AND public.nsai_actor_role()='service')
      OR actor=public.nsai_actor()) RETURNING actor INTO target;
 IF target IS NULL THEN RETURN false; END IF;

END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.nsai_oauth_state_put(p_state text, p_browser text, p_payload text)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF public.nsai_actor()<>'legacy-service' OR public.nsai_actor_role()<>'service'
    OR nullif(current_setting('nsai.job_id',true),'') IS NOT NULL THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'Authentication service only' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 IF p_state IS NULL OR p_state !~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$' OR p_browser IS NULL OR p_browser !~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'
    OR p_payload IS NULL OR octet_length(p_payload) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 8192 THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid authentication state'; END IF;
 PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(878734);

 IF (SELECT count(*) FROM public.oauth_pending_states)>=10000
    OR (SELECT count(*) FROM public.oauth_pending_states WHERE browser_hash=p_browser)>=8 THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'Authentication state capacity exceeded'; END IF;

END $function$
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.nsai_oauth_state_take(p_state text, p_browser text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE result text;
BEGIN
 IF public.nsai_actor()<>'legacy-service' OR public.nsai_actor_role()<>'service'
    OR nullif(current_setting('nsai.job_id',true),'') IS NOT NULL THEN

  AND expires_at>clock_timestamp() RETURNING payload INTO result;
 RETURN result;
END $function$
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.nsai_operation_begin(p_id text, p_kind text, p_users integer, p_personal integer, p_global integer, p_queue integer)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE old public.operation_admissions%ROWTYPE; next_state text;
BEGIN
 IF public.nsai_actor_role()<>'operator' OR nullif(current_setting('nsai.job_id',true),'') IS NOT NULL THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'Operation not permitted' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 IF p_id IS NULL OR p_id !~ '^[a-f0-9]{32}$' OR p_kind IS NULL OR p_kind NOT IN ('generation','ingestion')
    OR p_users IS NULL OR p_users NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 1000 OR p_personal IS NULL OR p_personal NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 100
    OR p_global IS NULL OR p_global NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 1000 OR p_queue IS NULL OR p_queue NOT BETWEEN 0 AND 1000 THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid operation admission'; END IF;
 PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(878733);
 UPDATE public.operation_admissions SET state='expired',finished_at=clock_timestamp()
  WHERE state IN ('active','queued') AND expires_at<=clock_timestamp();
 SELECT * INTO old FROM public.operation_admissions WHERE id=p_id;
 IF FOUND THEN
  IF old.actor<>public.nsai_actor() OR old.kind<>p_kind THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Operation unavailable' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
  RETURN old.state;
 END IF;
 IF (SELECT count(*) FROM public.operation_admissions WHERE actor=public.nsai_actor() AND kind=p_kind AND state IN ('queued','active'))>=p_personal THEN
  RETURN 'personal-limit'; END IF;
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.operation_admissions WHERE actor=public.nsai_actor() AND state IN ('queued','active'))
    AND (SELECT count(DISTINCT actor) FROM public.operation_admissions WHERE state IN ('queued','active'))>=p_users THEN
  RETURN 'user-limit'; END IF;
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.operation_admissions WHERE kind=p_kind AND state='queued')
    AND (SELECT count(*) FROM public.operation_admissions WHERE kind=p_kind AND state='active')<p_global THEN
  next_state='active';
 ELSE
  IF (SELECT count(*) FROM public.operation_admissions WHERE kind=p_kind AND state='queued')>=p_queue THEN RETURN 'queue-limit'; END IF;
  next_state='queued';
 END IF;
 INSERT INTO public.operation_admissions(id,actor,kind,state,expires_at)
  VALUES(p_id,public.nsai_actor(),p_kind,next_state,clock_timestamp()+interval '10 minutes');
 RETURN next_state;
END $function$
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.nsai_operation_claim(p_id text, p_global integer)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE old public.operation_admissions%ROWTYPE;
BEGIN
 IF p_global IS NULL OR p_global NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 1000 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid active operation bound'; END IF;
 IF public.nsai_actor_role()<>'operator' OR nullif(current_setting('nsai.job_id',true),'') IS NOT NULL THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'Operation not permitted' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(878733);
 UPDATE public.operation_admissions SET state='expired',finished_at=clock_timestamp()
  WHERE state IN ('active','queued') AND expires_at<=clock_timestamp();
 SELECT * INTO old FROM public.operation_admissions WHERE id=p_id;
 IF NOT FOUND OR old.actor<>public.nsai_actor() THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Operation unavailable' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 IF old.state<>'queued' THEN RETURN old.state; END IF;
 IF (SELECT count(*) FROM public.operation_admissions WHERE kind=old.kind AND state='active')<p_global
    AND p_id=(SELECT id FROM public.operation_admissions WHERE kind=old.kind AND state='queued' ORDER BY created_at,id LIMIT 1) THEN
  UPDATE public.operation_admissions SET state='active',expires_at=clock_timestamp()+interval '10 minutes' WHERE id=p_id;
  RETURN 'active';
 END IF;
 RETURN 'queued';
END $function$
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.nsai_operation_finish(p_id text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF public.nsai_actor_role()<>'operator' OR nullif(current_setting('nsai.job_id',true),'') IS NOT NULL THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'Operation not permitted' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(878733);
 UPDATE public.operation_admissions SET state='finished',finished_at=clock_timestamp()
  WHERE id=p_id AND actor=public.nsai_actor() AND state IN ('active','queued');

END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.nsai_private_authorize_read(doc text, actor text, actor_role text)
 RETURNS bigint
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE current_epoch bigint;
BEGIN
  IF actor_role IS NULL OR actor_role NOT IN ('operator','viewer','reviewer','admin')
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid role' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
  SELECT epoch INTO current_epoch FROM public.document_policy_versions
    WHERE document_id=doc FOR SHARE;
  -- Serialize group removal with this authorization/audit transaction, too.
  PERFORM p.group_id FROM public.private_groups p
    JOIN public.document_read_grants g ON g.subject_kind='group' AND g.subject_id=p.group_id
    WHERE g.document_id=doc ORDER BY p.group_id FOR SHARE OF p;
  IF current_epoch IS NULL OR NOT public.nsai_private_can_read(doc,actor)
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Source unavailable' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
  IF actor_role='admin' THEN
    INSERT INTO public.private_access_events(document_id,actor,event_type,epoch)
      VALUES(doc,actor,'privileged-read',current_epoch);
  END IF;
  RETURN current_epoch;
END $function$
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.nsai_private_can_read(doc text, actor text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.document_owners o WHERE o.document_id=doc AND
    (o.owner_actor=actor OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.document_read_grants g
      WHERE g.document_id=doc AND NOT g.revoked
        AND (g.expires_at IS NULL OR g.expires_at>clock_timestamp())
        AND ((g.subject_kind='user' AND g.subject_id=actor) OR
          (g.subject_kind='group' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.private_group_members m
            WHERE m.group_id=g.subject_id AND m.actor=actor))))));
$function$
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.nsai_private_membership(grp text, member_actor text, admin_actor text, expected_epoch bigint, remove_member boolean)
 RETURNS bigint
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE next_epoch bigint;
BEGIN
  IF remove_member IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid membership'; END IF;
  UPDATE public.private_groups SET epoch=epoch+1 WHERE group_id=grp AND epoch=expected_epoch
    RETURNING epoch INTO next_epoch;
  IF next_epoch IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Stale membership' USING ERRCODE='40001'; END IF;
  IF remove_member THEN
    DELETE FROM public.private_group_members WHERE group_id=grp AND actor=member_actor;
  ELSE
    INSERT INTO public.private_group_members VALUES(grp,member_actor) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;
  END IF;
  INSERT INTO public.private_access_events(group_id,actor,event_type,epoch,details)
    VALUES(grp,admin_actor,CASE WHEN remove_member THEN 'membership-remove' ELSE 'membership-add' END,
      next_epoch,jsonb_build_object('member',member_actor));
  RETURN next_epoch;
END $function$
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.nsai_private_own(doc text, actor text)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  -- Only new sources in this transaction may acquire an uploader identity.
  -- Mapping quarantined legacy evidence requires a separate explicit process.
  IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.documents WHERE id=doc AND xmin=pg_current_xact_id()::xid)
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Ownership requires a new source transaction'; END IF;
  INSERT INTO public.document_owners(document_id,owner_actor) VALUES(doc,actor);
  INSERT INTO public.document_policy_versions(document_id) VALUES(doc);
  INSERT INTO public.private_access_events(document_id,actor,event_type,epoch)
    VALUES(doc,actor,'owner',1);
END $function$
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.nsai_private_share(doc text, actor text, expected_epoch bigint, kind text, subject text, expiry timestamp with time zone, revoke boolean)
 RETURNS bigint
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE next_epoch bigint;
BEGIN
  IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.document_owners WHERE document_id=doc AND owner_actor=actor)
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Source unavailable' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
  IF revoke IS NULL OR (expiry IS NOT NULL AND expiry <= clock_timestamp())
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid grant'; END IF;
  IF kind='group' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.private_groups WHERE group_id=subject)
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid group'; END IF;
  UPDATE public.document_policy_versions SET epoch=epoch+1
    WHERE document_id=doc AND epoch=expected_epoch RETURNING epoch INTO next_epoch;
  IF next_epoch IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Stale policy' USING ERRCODE='40001'; END IF;
  INSERT INTO public.document_read_grants VALUES(doc,kind,subject,expiry,revoke)
    ON CONFLICT(document_id,subject_kind,subject_id) DO UPDATE
    SET expires_at=EXCLUDED.expires_at,revoked=EXCLUDED.revoked;
  INSERT INTO public.private_access_events(document_id,actor,event_type,epoch,details)
    VALUES(doc,actor,CASE WHEN revoke THEN 'revoke' ELSE 'share' END,next_epoch,
      jsonb_build_object('subject_kind',kind,'subject_id',subject,'expires_at',expiry));
  RETURN next_epoch;
END $function$
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.nsai_private_source_key()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF NEW.owner_scope='legacy-shared' THEN
    IF NEW.sha256 LIKE 'private/1/%' THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid source key' USING ERRCODE='42501';
    END IF;
  ELSE
    NEW.original_sha256=coalesce(NEW.original_sha256,NEW.sha256);
    NEW.sha256='private/1/' || NEW.owner_scope || '/' || NEW.original_sha256;
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END $function$
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.nsai_private_source_owner()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF NEW.owner_scope <> 'legacy-shared' THEN
    IF NEW.owner_scope <> public.nsai_actor() OR NEW.ingested_by <> public.nsai_actor()
      THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid source owner' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
    PERFORM public.nsai_private_own(NEW.id,NEW.owner_scope);
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END $function$
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.nsai_publish_semantic_job(job_id text, token uuid, embedding_sha text, active_actors text[])
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE job public.semantic_jobs; embedding public.knowledge_embeddings; sources text[];
BEGIN
  SELECT * INTO job FROM public.semantic_jobs WHERE id=job_id FOR UPDATE;
  IF NOT FOUND OR active_actors IS NULL OR cardinality(active_actors)>1000
    OR job.state<>'running' OR job.lease_token IS DISTINCT FROM token
    OR job.lease_expires_at<=clock_timestamp() OR job.requested_actor<>public.nsai_actor()
    OR job.id IS DISTINCT FROM current_setting('nsai.job_id',true)
    OR token::text IS DISTINCT FROM current_setting('nsai.job_lease',true)
    OR NOT public.nsai_job_source_allowed(job.document_id)
    OR NOT (job.requested_actor='legacy-service' OR job.requested_actor=ANY(active_actors))
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Stale or unauthorized job lease' USING ERRCODE='40001'; END IF;
  IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.documents d JOIN public.document_knowledge k ON k.document_id=d.id
    WHERE d.id=job.document_id AND d.source_version=job.source_revision AND d.original_sha256=job.source_sha256
      AND k.artifact_sha256=job.knowledge_sha256)
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Job source generation changed' USING ERRCODE='40001'; END IF;
  SELECT * INTO embedding FROM public.knowledge_embeddings WHERE document_id=job.document_id
    AND model_sha256=job.model_sha256 AND artifact_sha256=embedding_sha;
  IF NOT FOUND OR embedding.payload->>'source_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM job.source_sha256
    OR embedding.payload->>'knowledge_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM job.knowledge_sha256
    OR embedding.payload#>>'{model_identity,sha256}' IS DISTINCT FROM job.model_sha256
    OR NOT(job.document_id=ANY(embedding.source_ids))
    OR NOT public.nsai_sources_visible(embedding.source_ids,embedding.provenance_complete)
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Incomplete validated embedding generation'; END IF;
  UPDATE public.semantic_jobs SET state='succeeded',lease_token=NULL,lease_expires_at=NULL
    WHERE id=job.id AND lease_expires_at>clock_timestamp();
  IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Expired publication lease' USING ERRCODE='40001'; END IF;
  INSERT INTO public.semantic_publications(id,document_id,model_sha256,knowledge_sha256,embedding_sha256,source_ids)
    VALUES(job.id,job.document_id,job.model_sha256,job.knowledge_sha256,embedding_sha,embedding.source_ids);
  UPDATE public.source_index_state SET current_publication_id=job.id,state='ready',epoch=epoch+1
    WHERE document_id=job.document_id AND pending_job_id=job.id;
  IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Job replaced before publication' USING ERRCODE='40001'; END IF;
  INSERT INTO public.semantic_job_events(job_id,event_type,attempt) VALUES(job.id,'published',job.attempts);
  PERFORM public.nsai_clear_semantic_checkpoints(job.id);
  RETURN job.id;
END $function$
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.nsai_put_semantic_checkpoints(job_id text, token uuid, records jsonb)
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE job public.semantic_jobs; item jsonb; previous text; saved integer=0; norm double precision;
BEGIN
  job=public.nsai_checkpoint_lease(job_id,token);
  IF records IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof(records)<>'array' OR jsonb_array_length(records) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 8
    OR octet_length(records::text)>1024*1024 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Checkpoint batch budget exceeded'; END IF;
  IF (SELECT coalesce(sum(pg_column_size(vector)+pg_column_size(coverage)),0) FROM public.semantic_job_vectors WHERE semantic_job_vectors.job_id=job.id)
    +octet_length(records::text)>16*1024*1024 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Checkpoint storage budget exceeded'; END IF;
  FOR item IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(records) LOOP
    IF item->>'node_id' IS NULL OR item->>'node_id' !~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'
      OR jsonb_typeof(item->'vector') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array' OR jsonb_array_length(item->'vector')<>384
      OR jsonb_typeof(item->'coverage') IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'
      OR item->'coverage'->'complete' IS DISTINCT FROM 'true'::jsonb
      OR (item->'coverage'->>'input_tokens') IS NULL
      OR (item->'coverage'->>'input_tokens')::integer NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 32768
      OR item->'coverage'->>'covered_tokens' IS DISTINCT FROM item->'coverage'->>'input_tokens'
      OR item->'coverage'->>'max_sequence_length' IS DISTINCT FROM '256'
      OR item->'coverage'->>'pooling' IS DISTINCT FROM 'token-mean-overlap-compensated-special-mean'
      OR item->>'artifact_sha256' IS NULL OR item->>'artifact_sha256' !~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'
      OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(item->'vector') value WHERE jsonb_typeof(value)<>'number')
      OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.document_knowledge k,jsonb_array_elements(k.knowledge->'nodes') node
        WHERE k.document_id=job.document_id AND k.artifact_sha256=job.knowledge_sha256
          AND node->>'kind'='passage' AND node->>'id'=item->>'node_id')
      THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid source-bound checkpoint'; END IF;
    SELECT sum((value::text)::double precision*(value::text)::double precision) INTO norm
      FROM jsonb_array_elements(item->'vector') value;
    IF norm IS NULL OR norm NOT BETWEEN 0.999 AND 1.001 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Checkpoint vector is not normalized'; END IF;
    SELECT artifact_sha256 INTO previous FROM public.semantic_job_vectors
      WHERE semantic_job_vectors.job_id=job.id AND node_id=item->>'node_id';
    IF previous IS NOT NULL AND previous<>item->>'artifact_sha256'
      THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Checkpoint content changed'; END IF;
    INSERT INTO public.semantic_job_vectors(job_id,node_id,vector,coverage,artifact_sha256)
      VALUES(job.id,item->>'node_id',item->'vector',item->'coverage',item->>'artifact_sha256') ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;
    saved=saved+1;
  END LOOP;
  RETURN saved;
END $function$
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.nsai_readable_claim_projection(selected text[], revision_filter text, page_filter integer[], active_only boolean)
 RETURNS TABLE(id text, subject text, predicate text, value text, locator text, document_id text, revision integer, reviewed_by text, status text, source_ids text[], provenance_complete boolean, original_sha256 text, created_at timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
 SET plan_cache_mode TO 'force_custom_plan'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF coalesce(current_setting('nsai.job_id',true),'')<>'' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Request context required' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
  IF active_only IS NULL OR (revision_filter IS NOT NULL AND length(revision_filter) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 50)
    OR (selected IS NOT NULL AND (cardinality(selected) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 1000 OR array_ndims(selected)<>1
      OR array_lower(selected,1)<>1 OR array_position(selected,NULL) IS NOT NULL
      OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM unnest(selected) item WHERE length(item) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 200)))
    OR (page_filter IS NOT NULL AND (cardinality(page_filter) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 100 OR array_ndims(page_filter)<>1
      OR array_lower(page_filter,1)<>1 OR array_position(page_filter,NULL) IS NOT NULL
      OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM unnest(page_filter) item WHERE item NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 1000))) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid claim scope' USING ERRCODE='22023'; END IF;
  RETURN QUERY
  WITH parent_ids AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.document_id FROM public.claims c
      WHERE (NOT active_only OR c.status NOT IN ('superseded','rejected'))
        AND (selected IS NULL OR c.document_id=ANY(selected))
  ), permitted AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT p.document_id FROM parent_ids p
      WHERE public.nsai_index_source_readable(p.document_id)
  ), primary_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT c.id,c.subject,c.predicate,c.value,c.locator,c.document_id,c.revision,
      c.reviewed_by,c.status,c.source_ids,c.provenance_complete,d.original_sha256,c.created_at
    FROM permitted p
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
      SELECT d.original_sha256 FROM public.documents d WHERE d.id=p.document_id
        AND (revision_filter IS NULL OR d.source_version=revision_filter) OFFSET 0
    ) d
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
      SELECT c.* FROM public.claims c WHERE c.document_id=p.document_id
        AND (NOT active_only OR c.status NOT IN ('superseded','rejected'))
        AND (page_filter IS NULL OR (c.locator LIKE 'page:%'
          AND split_part(c.locator,':',2)=ANY(ARRAY(SELECT item::text FROM unnest(page_filter) item)))) OFFSET 0
    ) c
  ), dependency_keys AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.document_id,(c.status='candidate') AS candidate,c.source_ids,c.provenance_complete
      FROM primary_rows c
  ), allowed_dependencies AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT k.* FROM dependency_keys k WHERE CASE
      WHEN k.candidate THEN true
      WHEN public.nsai_legacy_context() AND NOT k.provenance_complete THEN true
      ELSE k.document_id=ANY(k.source_ids) AND public.nsai_sources_visible(k.source_ids,k.provenance_complete)
    END
  )
  SELECT c.* FROM primary_rows c JOIN allowed_dependencies k
    ON k.document_id=c.document_id AND k.candidate=(c.status='candidate')
      AND k.source_ids IS NOT DISTINCT FROM c.source_ids
      AND k.provenance_complete=c.provenance_complete;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.nsai_register_source_manifest(sources text[])
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE normalized text[]; checksum text; result text;
BEGIN
  IF coalesce(current_setting('nsai.job_id',true),'')<>'' OR sources IS NULL
    OR cardinality(sources)>1000 OR array_position(sources,NULL) IS NOT NULL
    OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM unnest(sources) value WHERE length(value) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 128)
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid request source set' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
  SELECT coalesce(array_agg(DISTINCT value ORDER BY value),ARRAY[]::text[]) INTO normalized FROM unnest(sources) value;
  IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM unnest(normalized) source WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.documents WHERE id=source))
    OR NOT public.nsai_sources_visible(normalized,true) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Source unavailable' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
  checksum=encode(sha256(convert_to(array_to_json(normalized)::text,'UTF8')),'hex');
  INSERT INTO public.source_dependency_manifests(actor,content_sha256,source_ids)
    VALUES(public.nsai_actor(),checksum,normalized) ON CONFLICT(actor,content_sha256) DO NOTHING;
  SELECT id INTO result FROM public.source_dependency_manifests
    WHERE actor=public.nsai_actor() AND content_sha256=checksum AND source_ids=normalized;
  IF result IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Source manifest integrity mismatch'; END IF;
  RETURN result;
END $function$
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.nsai_reserve_cost(p_id text, p_account text, p_provider text, p_estimate bigint, p_input bigint, p_output bigint)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE old public.cost_reservations%ROWTYPE; account_row public.cost_accounts%ROWTYPE; total public.cost_accounts%ROWTYPE;
BEGIN
 IF p_account LIKE 'cash-%' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Cash dispatch is prohibited; governance demonstration only' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 IF public.nsai_actor_role() NOT IN ('operator','service') OR nullif(current_setting('nsai.job_id',true),'') IS NOT NULL THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'Cost reservation not permitted' USING ERRCODE='42501';
 END IF;
 IF p_id IS NULL OR p_id !~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$' OR p_account IS NULL OR p_account='cash-total'
    OR p_provider IS NULL OR p_provider !~ '^[a-z][a-z0-9_-]{0,63}$'
    OR p_estimate IS NULL OR p_estimate NOT BETWEEN 0 AND 1000000000000
    OR p_input IS NULL OR p_input NOT BETWEEN 0 AND 1000000000
    OR p_output IS NULL OR p_output NOT BETWEEN 0 AND 1000000000 THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid cost reservation';
 END IF;
 -- One short global ledger lock gives deterministic cross-bucket lock ordering.
 PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(878732);
 SELECT * INTO old FROM public.cost_reservations WHERE id=p_id;
 IF FOUND THEN
  IF old.actor<>public.nsai_actor() OR old.account<>p_account OR old.provider<>p_provider
     OR old.estimate_units<>p_estimate OR old.input_token_ceiling<>p_input OR old.output_token_ceiling<>p_output THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'Cost reservation unavailable' USING ERRCODE='42501';
  END IF;
  RETURN p_id;
 END IF;
 SELECT * INTO account_row FROM public.cost_accounts WHERE name=p_account FOR UPDATE;
 IF NOT FOUND OR NOT account_row.enabled OR account_row.spent_units+account_row.reserved_units+p_estimate>account_row.limit_units THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'Provider or allocation unavailable';
 END IF;
 IF p_account LIKE 'cash-%' THEN
  SELECT * INTO STRICT total FROM public.cost_accounts WHERE name='cash-total' FOR UPDATE;
  IF NOT total.enabled OR total.spent_units+total.reserved_units+p_estimate>total.limit_units THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'Cash exposure ceiling reached';
  END IF;
  UPDATE public.cost_accounts SET reserved_units=reserved_units+p_estimate WHERE name='cash-total';
 END IF;
 UPDATE public.cost_accounts SET reserved_units=reserved_units+p_estimate WHERE name=p_account;
 INSERT INTO public.cost_reservations(id,actor,account,provider,estimate_units,input_token_ceiling,output_token_ceiling)
 VALUES(p_id,public.nsai_actor(),p_account,p_provider,p_estimate,p_input,p_output);
 INSERT INTO public.cost_events(reservation_id,actor,kind,units) VALUES(p_id,public.nsai_actor(),'reserved',p_estimate);
 RETURN p_id;
END $function$
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.nsai_retry_semantic_job(doc text, expected_epoch bigint)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE job public.semantic_jobs; state_row public.source_index_state; target_job text;
BEGIN
  IF public.nsai_actor_role() IS DISTINCT FROM 'operator' OR coalesce(current_setting('nsai.job_id',true),'')<>'' OR
    NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.document_owners WHERE document_id=doc AND owner_actor=public.nsai_actor())
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Source unavailable' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
  SELECT pending_job_id INTO target_job FROM public.source_index_state WHERE document_id=doc;
  SELECT * INTO job FROM public.semantic_jobs WHERE id=target_job FOR UPDATE;
  SELECT * INTO state_row FROM public.source_index_state WHERE document_id=doc FOR UPDATE;
  IF NOT FOUND OR job.id IS NULL OR expected_epoch IS NULL OR expected_epoch<1 OR state_row.epoch<>expected_epoch OR state_row.pending_job_id IS DISTINCT FROM job.id
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Stale index state' USING ERRCODE='40001'; END IF;
  IF job.state NOT IN('failed','cancelled') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Only failed or cancelled indexing can be retried' USING ERRCODE='40001'; END IF;
  UPDATE public.semantic_jobs SET state='queued',attempts=0,available_at=clock_timestamp(),error_code=NULL WHERE id=job.id;
  UPDATE public.source_index_state SET state='queued',epoch=epoch+1 WHERE document_id=doc;
  INSERT INTO public.semantic_job_events(job_id,event_type,attempt,control_details) VALUES(job.id,'requeued',0,jsonb_build_object('actor',public.nsai_actor(),'expected_epoch',expected_epoch,'epoch',state_row.epoch+1,'previous_state',job.state));
  RETURN job.id;
END $function$
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.nsai_semantic_storage_account()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE previous_bytes bigint=0; next_bytes bigint=0; used bigint; limits bigint[];
BEGIN
  PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(878712);
  IF TG_OP<>'INSERT' THEN previous_bytes=octet_length(OLD.payload::text); END IF;
  IF TG_OP<>'DELETE' THEN next_bytes=octet_length(NEW.payload::text); END IF;
  limits=public.nsai_capacity_limits();
  SELECT canonical_bytes INTO STRICT used FROM public.semantic_storage_usage WHERE singleton FOR UPDATE;
  IF next_bytes>previous_bytes AND used-previous_bytes+next_bytes>limits[3] THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Semantic artifact storage capacity reached' USING ERRCODE='54000'; END IF;
  UPDATE public.semantic_storage_usage SET canonical_bytes=used-previous_bytes+next_bytes WHERE singleton;
  IF TG_OP='DELETE' THEN RETURN OLD; END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END $function$
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.nsai_set_semantic_job_priority(doc text, expected_epoch bigint, requested_priority integer)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE job public.semantic_jobs; observed public.source_index_state; target text; next_epoch bigint;
BEGIN
 IF public.nsai_actor_role() IS DISTINCT FROM 'operator' OR coalesce(current_setting('nsai.job_id',true),'')<>'' OR NOT public.nsai_source_is_owner(doc)
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Source unavailable' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 SELECT pending_job_id INTO target FROM public.source_index_state WHERE document_id=doc;
 SELECT * INTO job FROM public.semantic_jobs WHERE id=target FOR UPDATE;
 SELECT * INTO observed FROM public.source_index_state WHERE document_id=doc FOR UPDATE;
 IF NOT FOUND OR job.id IS NULL OR expected_epoch IS NULL OR expected_epoch<1 OR observed.epoch<>expected_epoch OR observed.pending_job_id IS DISTINCT FROM job.id
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Stale index state' USING ERRCODE='40001'; END IF;
 IF job.requested_actor IS DISTINCT FROM public.nsai_actor() THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Source unavailable' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 IF requested_priority IS NULL OR requested_priority NOT BETWEEN 0 AND 9 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Priority must be an integer from 0 through 9' USING ERRCODE='22023'; END IF;
 IF job.state<>'queued' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Only queued indexing can change priority' USING ERRCODE='40001'; END IF;
 UPDATE public.semantic_jobs SET priority=requested_priority WHERE id=job.id;
 UPDATE public.source_index_state SET epoch=epoch+1 WHERE document_id=doc RETURNING epoch INTO next_epoch;
 INSERT INTO public.semantic_job_events(job_id,event_type,attempt,control_details) VALUES(job.id,'priority-changed',job.attempts,jsonb_build_object('actor',public.nsai_actor(),'expected_epoch',expected_epoch,'epoch',next_epoch,'previous_priority',job.priority,'priority',requested_priority));
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('job_id',job.id,'state','queued','priority',requested_priority,'epoch',next_epoch);
END $function$
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.nsai_settle_cost(p_id text, p_actual bigint, p_input bigint, p_output bigint)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE old public.cost_reservations%ROWTYPE; overrun boolean;
BEGIN
 IF public.nsai_actor_role() NOT IN ('operator','service') OR nullif(current_setting('nsai.job_id',true),'') IS NOT NULL THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'Cost settlement not permitted' USING ERRCODE='42501';
 END IF;
 IF p_actual IS NULL OR p_actual NOT BETWEEN 0 AND 1000000000000
    OR p_input IS NULL OR p_input NOT BETWEEN 0 AND 1000000000
    OR p_output IS NULL OR p_output NOT BETWEEN 0 AND 1000000000 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid cost settlement'; END IF;
 PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(878732);
 SELECT * INTO old FROM public.cost_reservations WHERE id=p_id FOR UPDATE;
 IF NOT FOUND OR old.actor<>public.nsai_actor() THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Cost reservation unavailable' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 IF old.state='settled' THEN
  IF old.actual_units<>p_actual OR old.input_tokens<>p_input OR old.output_tokens<>p_output THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Settlement conflict'; END IF;
  RETURN p_id;
 END IF;
 -- Record a real provider overrun even when it exceeds the reservation or budget.
 -- Freeze new admission; never discard an invoice merely to keep a ledger green.
 overrun=p_actual>old.estimate_units OR p_input>old.input_token_ceiling OR p_output>old.output_token_ceiling;
 UPDATE public.cost_accounts SET reserved_units=reserved_units-old.estimate_units,
  spent_units=spent_units+p_actual,
  enabled=enabled AND NOT overrun AND spent_units+reserved_units-old.estimate_units+p_actual<=limit_units
 WHERE name=old.account OR (old.account LIKE 'cash-%' AND name='cash-total');
 UPDATE public.cost_reservations SET state='settled',actual_units=p_actual,input_tokens=p_input,output_tokens=p_output,settled_at=now() WHERE id=p_id;
 INSERT INTO public.cost_events(reservation_id,actor,kind,units) VALUES(p_id,public.nsai_actor(),'settled',p_actual);
 RETURN p_id;
END $function$
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.nsai_source_capacity_available(proposed_claims integer)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE limits bigint[]=public.nsai_capacity_limits();
BEGIN
  IF proposed_claims IS NULL OR proposed_claims NOT BETWEEN 0 AND 2000 THEN RETURN false; END IF;
  PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(878704);
  RETURN (SELECT count(*) FROM public.documents)<limits[1]
     AND (SELECT count(*) FROM public.claims)+proposed_claims<=limits[2];
END $function$
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.nsai_source_index_status(doc text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE total_passages bigint; coverage_complete boolean;
BEGIN
  IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.documents WHERE id=doc) OR NOT public.nsai_document_visible(doc)
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Source unavailable' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
  SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(k.knowledge->'nodes','[]'::jsonb)) node
    WHERE node->>'kind'='passage'),(k.knowledge#>>'{extraction_coverage,complete}')::boolean
    INTO total_passages,coverage_complete FROM public.document_knowledge k
    WHERE k.document_id=doc AND ((public.nsai_legacy_context() AND NOT k.provenance_complete)
      OR public.nsai_sources_visible(k.source_ids,k.provenance_complete));
  RETURN coalesce((SELECT jsonb_build_object('document_id',doc,'state',s.state,'epoch',s.epoch,
    'ready',s.current_publication_id IS NOT NULL AND public.nsai_index_source_readable(doc),'publication_id',s.current_publication_id,
    'job_id',j.id,'job_state',j.state,'priority',j.priority,'attempts',j.attempts,'error_code',j.error_code,'passages_total',total_passages,
    'source_coverage_complete',coverage_complete,
    'passages_completed',CASE WHEN total_passages IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN j.state='succeeded' THEN total_passages ELSE
      (SELECT count(*) FROM public.semantic_job_vectors v WHERE v.job_id=j.id) END)
    FROM public.source_index_state s LEFT JOIN public.semantic_jobs j ON j.id=s.pending_job_id WHERE s.document_id=doc),
    jsonb_build_object('document_id',doc,'state','not-commissioned','ready',false));
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.nsai_source_manifest_sources(manifest_id text)
 RETURNS text[]
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE manifest public.source_dependency_manifests;
BEGIN
  IF coalesce(current_setting('nsai.job_id',true),'')<>'' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Request context required' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
  SELECT * INTO manifest FROM public.source_dependency_manifests WHERE id=manifest_id;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.nsai_source_scope_allows(doc text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
